attributes.myAttDisclosureMessage: DIRECTV: New U.S. customers only. Must prepay first 2 months of service at full price. Online orders will be shipped in 1 to 3 days by FedEx Ground® to the address provided. Non-refundable. Offer limited to 1 per DIRECTV account; 2 per household. Not combinable with select offers.
